beforePause.dialog:
FIELD CONFIGURATION
×
MAKE IT YOURS.
SCENE BRIGHTNESS
1.30×

Raise this for dark cover or lower it for a deeper storm mood. 1.00× restores the original scene lighting. HUD brightness stays fixed.

TOUCH LOOK SENSITIVITY
1.00×
Faster long scene turns

FIRE uses finer small drags and ramps up for longer turns. Scene swipes scale with screen width for quick portrait turns; optional long swipes turn faster. AIM gives finer corrections with a magnified view. Lower sensitivity for finer aim.

Tap visible targets to aim

A short scene tap on or near a visible enemy or coil centers a real surface within 36 m. Small finger-position errors are forgiven; nearer cover, the weapon and HUD still block selection. AIM SET confirms an accepted tap; AIM UNCHANGED means no selection was made. Neither promises a hit. The message clears when you drag, fire, switch weapons or leave play. It does not fire or track. Cover blocks selection. Drags still turn normally. Both weapons; using this joins touch-assisted personal bests.

Rifle aim assistance

Helps near misses reach visible targets. Cover still blocks shots. Rifle only; a cyan reticle ring acknowledges assisted aim or a shot. Assisted scores have a separate personal best.

Hold-forward auto vault

Hold MOVE forward against low cover to vault. Release MOVE before it starts, or use AIM, to stay behind cover. Auto vault pauses during firing, reload, crouch and held action button. JUMP still vaults manually.

THREAT LEVEL
Recon — more forgiving
Operator — intended experience
Veteran — high stakes

Threat level applies to your next deployment.

GRAPHICS QUALITY
Performance — lower resolution, no shadows
Balanced — recommended
High — sharper, more demanding
MASTER VOLUME
65%
Contextual route help

Shows the next clear ground step while walking. Stops during aiming or firing. Tap MAP to choose a destination. Patrols still matter.

REDUCED CAMERA MOTION

Reduces view bob, recoil movement, and screen effects.

APPLY & CLOSE
↗
